summary: Completed comprehensive testing of IPDR/CDR Intelligence Analysis System. Backend APIs fully functional with 100% success rate. Frontend workflow tested successfully including case creation, subject management, file uploads, and analysis execution. All 12 analysis correlation types are implemented and working.

ui_bugs.issue: DOM element detachment during upload process causes script interruption
ui_bugs.note: Functional issue only affects automated testing, not user experience

passed_tests: Backend API root endpoint responds correctly
Case details retrieval via GET /api/cases/{id} works
File upload via POST /api/cases/{id}/upload works for all 4 test files
Analysis execution via POST /api/cases/{id}/analyze works with all 12 sections
PDF report download via GET /api/cases/{id}/report/pdf works
DOCX report download via GET /api/cases/{id}/report/docx works
Dashboard loads with dark tactical theme
Case creation dialog and form functionality
File upload functionality for CDR and IPDR data
Tab navigation between Overview, Upload, Analysis, and Report tabs
